notes.title: What’s Coming in Version 1.6.0
notes.notes:
Since July 18, when Countless Army celebrated its anniversary, there haven’t been any new updates. But don’t worry — the wait will be worth it!

In the next version, I’ll be reworking the rebellion system, making rebellions function in a different way so they feel less frustrating. On top of that, they’ll be enhanced with challenges, as a rebelled province will now include specific objectives you’ll need to complete in order to reclaim it. This will make rebellions a much more engaging challenge.

But that’s not all: some of these challenges will be exclusive to Hard Mode, which will now be renamed Game+ Mode. Even now, this mode already includes several hurdles that require prior knowledge of the game, so it makes more sense to introduce it after the first playthrough instead of offering it right from the start.

These are early ideas and, as always, they may change during development — or even include surprises not mentioned here (as has happened with every past version). As I progress, I’ll be sharing more updates little by little.

I hope you enjoyed version 1.5.0 and its summer event, and that you’ll also be excited about what’s coming with version 1.6.0.

notes.title: Balance Tweaks, Visual Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This small update comes to polish the game's balance, improve defense information visibility, and fix several bugs that have been reported.


Balance Adjustments
Everlasting has been rebalanced due to being too difficult.

Bauble has been adjusted because one of its routes was harder than intended.

South Canicula has also been rebalanced for the same reason.

The number of Watchers summoned per division has been reduced from 6 to 3.

The cooldown (CD) of Watchers has increased from 5 to 10 seconds.


Changes
All minimaps have been revised to remove the red areas that indicated defense positions.*

All map routes have been adjusted to better match the actual paths.

All conquerable buildings have been revised to ensure the improvements are fully visible within the camera view.

The Armory now gives 5 bonus resources, or 10 if you've already conquered the capital of the kingdom.

Defense signs have been visually redesigned and now adapt better to the screen:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/39a2a6219e39cf0b584838ee35571f01e1d33941.png"]

If a defense is placed high on the screen, its sign will now appear below it to remain visible.

Several signs have had their position corrected to ensure proper centering.

In gamepad mode, the display of signs has been reworked to avoid overcrowding the screen.



*While removing the red zones might seem like a negative change, the new defense system with strengths and weaknesses means knowing the defense's location doesn't help much—you still don’t know its type or which troops will be most effective until you engage.


Bug Fixes
The Dragon could get stuck at the end of the path when trying to use a spell.

The Necromancer could also get stuck in the same situation.

Occasionally, selecting the resource option when upgrading the Armory caused a bug where no resources were received at the end of the invasion.

In the load game / new game screen, the conquered provinces on saved files were overlapping visually.

The DF skin for the Entremundos had an incorrect walking animation, making it look like it was constantly dying.

The army setup template would reset each time a troop was selected on the upgrade or skin screen.

The descriptive text for building choices after conquest was not centered when the camera was zoomed in.

In gamepad mode, it was impossible to replay maps from the expansion.

A visual bug caused mission 1 of the mini expansion to appear selected when it wasn’t (and vice versa) in gamepad mode.

Some windmills were incorrectly interpreting which defense unit had entered them.

notes.title: Version 1.5.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.5.0 is here—just in time to celebrate Countless Army’s anniversary!

And of course… the Liche is throwing a beach party, and you’re all invited!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/6364c9e7e0c44685cca232dc0ea8f5727b44a289.png"]



To mark the occasion, party posters have appeared all across Ocelis. There are 6 in total, scattered throughout the different realms.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/db36815db7a30387a02e3e80ea076eb46ef96e12.png"]

If your troops walk past them… you’ll unlock exclusive beach party-themed skins!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7d78c86a2589e93dc30c2c01eb353d6c07c89e8b.png"]

Soldier – Surfer

Emaciated – Duck Splash

Standard bearer – Super Fan

Reaper – Lifeguard

Mass – Jelly

Necromancer – Lich Fan

The event will run from July 18th to August 1st.
Collect them all before the party ends!


But beware... This update isn't all fun and games: the Lich has gotten serious, sharpened his vision, and made the balance of power shine...


The Lich’s Visión

[previewyoutube="WkWgXfOfnBc;full"][/previewyoutube]


As you can see, almost all of the visual noise from the ground has been removed, and new details have been added as well. The realm where these changes shine the most is Canicula, where even new decorative elements—like cacti—have been introduced.


Shield Spell
First, the shield spell is getting an adjustment: instead of being a permanent shield, it will now last for 5 seconds. To compensate, the cooldown (CD) will be reduced from 40 to 20 seconds. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f21d6a90add179ad446cbc5567ef5a52df57e5c4.gif"] This will make the spell much more strategic, rather than something you just use every time the cooldown resets.   
Skill Tree Selection
Several people (unfortunately I don’t have their names noted) suggested it would be better if selected upgrades in the skill tree were marked with a circle to make them clearer.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/64ae4eb12a459d051ddfa9708adeab0eba956b9d.png"]
Changes to Troop Cards
Until now, troop cards had a fairly basic design, and even caused some visual issues with certain units — especially the Emaciated, which would almost disappear into the background.

They’ve now been redesigned to be clearer, more visually appealing, and to avoid these problems.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/26f1704187316d6597632bd5eb144f3749d84ece.gif"]

As you can see, this update applies to both troop cards and profession cards.


The Lich’s Balance
All troops and defensive units have been rebalanced, with adjustments to all their stats. Additionally, an important change has been made to the “CD” (cooldown) stat, which now no longer affects the time between divisions, but the time between units within the same division.

For those who want more details, a full breakdown of all balance changes can be found below in the news. For those who prefer a quick overview: the game is much more balanced and demands greater strategy.



I hope you enjoy all the new features that version 1.5.0 brings. Here are the patch notes.

Gameplay changes:

The "Cooldown" (CD) stat has completely changed its meaning. Previously, it affected how fast the next division on the route was summoned; now it determines how fast the units of that same division are summoned, meaning the shorter it is, the closer together the entire division will be summoned.

The old "Cooldown" (CD) for summoning troops on the route is now a fixed value of 5 seconds.

All troop health upgrades have been changed; they now increase more depending on the resources you use. Increase1 in Kingdom 1, Increase2 in Kingdom 2, Increase3 in Kingdom 3, Increase4 in Kingdom 4, and Increase5 in Kingdom 5. Example: Soldier, upgrades in Kingdom 1 give +5 health per upgrade; in Kingdom 2 +10 (52); Kingdom 3 +15 (53).

Troops

Soldier base health changed from 45 to 35. Max health now 335, before 105;

Skeletal Dog base health from 15 to 25. Max health now 175, before 48;

Emaciated base health from 16 to 20. Max health now 165, before 46;

Standard bearer base health from 25 to 50. Max health now 650, before 85;

Knight base health from 140 to 150. Max health now 1050, before 380;

Banshee base health remains 30. Max health now 180, before 50;

Reaper base health from 100 to 200. Max health now 200, before 100;

Bothworlders base health from 50 to 100. Max health now 550, before 80;

Mass base health remains 100. Max health now 1300, before 500;

Observer base health from 20 to 80. Max health now 200, before 230;

Necromancer base health remains 100. Max health now 400, before 180;

Dragon base health remains 600. Max health now 3300, before 6450;

New formula for health upgrades:

Total health = base health + (own increase * kingdom upgrade * amount upgraded)

This means:

Base health = the troop’s base health.

Own increase = amount of health gained per upgrade.

Kingdom upgrade = the upgrade multiplier by kingdom; the first kingdom multiplies upgrade amount by 1. Example: Soldier gains 5 (5x1) health per upgrade in first kingdom, 10 (5x2) in second, 15 (5x3) in third, 20 (5x4) in fourth...

Amount upgraded = number of upgrades applied.

*This is representative.

The Necromancer has been tweaked. Now his base summons 2 Rotten instead of 3; the Cadaveric summons 3 Rotten and the Noble summons 1 Soldier.

The Knight’s conquest value when entering a building has changed from 1 to 2.

The Mass’s conquest value when entering a building changed from 4/2/1 to 2/1/0.5 (large/medium/small).

The Standard bearer, Reaper, Necromancer, and Dragon troops now summon 2 units instead of 1.

CD has completely changed; now the unit CD upgrade does not affect the speed at which a new division is summoned, but the units inside that division. This makes the upgrade more noticeable, as troops will appear closer together as you upgrade.

The old CD system has been replaced by a fixed 5 seconds between divisions.

The Motivating Flagbearer increases the defense it gives to nearby units from 20% to 25%.

The Rotten Horde profession now also reduces the time between unit summons by 10%.

The Interworlds fade-out animation has been shortened so it is less visually heavy.

Defenses

Strengths and weaknesses are now more noticeable since the formula was changed to give them more impact.

Defenses now increase attack speed for each capital you have conquered.

Defenses now increase attack damage for each capital you have conquered. This also happened before but the formula was changed to fit the new troop health system.

All defenses have had their damage values changed to adapt to the new format and balance according to their usefulness.

The Ground Trap and Explosive Trebuchet have changed damage from fixed to fixed + percentage.

Now defenses that are... (seems this line is incomplete)

Weaknesses and strengths of all defenses are now the same: -25% damage on weaknesses and +25% damage on strengths.

The Archer changes its strength to light and its weakness to medium.

Spells

The area healing spell has been updated; now it is a mixed heal, half by percentage of health and half fixed health, with adjusted numbers for the new troop health system.

The healing area of the Mill has been updated; now it is a mixed heal, half by percentage of health and half fixed health, with adjusted numbers for the new troop health system. It has half the power of the spell.

The shield spell has been changed; the shield is no longer infinite but lasts 5 seconds. Also, its cooldown was reduced from 40 seconds to 20 seconds to be able to cast again faster. This makes it a more interesting and strategic spell.

Conquerables

The Runic Camp has been modified; its negative health factor is now -25%.

The Lumberjack Camp has been modified; its negative factor of increased damage to defenses is now +25%, and its small health bonus +12.5%, medium health +25%, large health +50%.

The Mining Camp has been modified; its small CD bonus is now -6.25% time between summons, medium bonus -12.5%, and large bonus -25%.

The Outpost has been modified; now its negative factor increases time between summoned units by +25%.

The Time Obelisk upgrade has been balanced. Now the spell duration increase is percentage based, increasing the base duration of each spell by 50% (the new shield is affected).

notes.title: What’s Coming in Version 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Last week we said goodbye to the Toledo Matsuri event, but it's not all bad news, I'm here to talk about version 1.5.0.

Toledo Matsuri was a great experience for me, as it was my first time participating in a live, in-person event. Thanks to that, and to all the feedback I received, I noticed that some aspects of the game could use a bit of refinement. Specifically, the tileset graphics and the overall game balance. Let’s dive a bit deeper into these two areas.

The Lich’s Vision
Tileset Graphics

For those unfamiliar with the term, a tileset is a collection of graphics used for the environment—floors, walls… and in this case, I’m referring to the floors in Countless Army.

At launch, Countless Army looked slightly different. I made a small visual improvement to reduce visual noise, but I feel that wasn’t quite enough. Here’s a small preview of what’s coming:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f2cbd37b7ac31fe1955cb45241424ca0f6fb4d73.gif

As you can see, the floors and paths have been simplified to make them less visually overwhelming. It’s still in development, so I’d really appreciate any feedback or suggestions you may have.

This update will apply to every map in the game.

The Lich’s Balance
Game Balance

Do you think there's a troop that feels too weak or too strong? Would you like to see any unit tweaked or reworked in some way? Drop a comment. I’ll consider your suggestion for update!

Watching people play live made me realize that troop stats need a proper review. That’s why, in the next update, I plan to go over all unit attributes… and also defenses.

This process will be quite interesting, as I’m even considering adjusting the "CD" stat so that, instead of marking distance between divisions, it will define the spacing between units within a division.

If you enjoy the more technical side of things, I’d love to publish a devblog-style post with deeper insights into this topic, so stay tuned.

These are the main changes coming in version 1.5.0, but they won’t be the only ones!

Thank you all so much for playing Countless Army!

notes.title: Interface Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
During the Toledo Matsuri in-person event, I was able to spot some bugs and notice that certain elements needed adjustments to improve the player experience.

This quick and small update is intended to fix the issues I observed during the event and also to introduce an improvement focused on the upgrade menus when capturing a building.

The improvement makes it so that, when the camera is zoomed out, the upgrade menu automatically scales up as well, allowing for better visibility. Additionally, I’ve added some visual feedback when hovering over the buttons, which was previously missing. Here’s a quick look at that change (este cambio fue propuesto hace tiempo por "McStuffins T. Fox"):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/14122e6daa8b01e73e3675aa070773d7b0579cee.gif


Here’s a list of the changes made in this update:
 The Necromancer had a bug that prevented it from summoning troops.
 Anti-air defenses, the "Needles", did not speed up along with the game speed.
 The "exit match" button removed the dark overlay of the pause screen.
 Upgrade menus when capturing a building now also scale up when the camera is zoomed out, making them easier to see.
 Upgrade buttons are now highlighted when you hover over them.
 Upgrade descriptions now appear regardless of which of the three options you are selecting.
 Continuously pressing the "Cancel Invasion" button would cause the game to freeze.
 The "Shinigami" skin from the Toledo Matsuri event had a bug and couldn’t be obtained.
 Spell cooldown numbers were not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
 Flag numbers were also not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
 Some bushes had incorrect depth values, causing them to appear over other objects in the scene.
 The defense stats panel would appear even when the final menu or camera mode was active.


Thank you all so much for playing Countless Army!

notes.title: What's Coming in Countless Army's 1.4.0 Update!
notes.notes:
The upcoming 1.4.0 update is on its way and will bring improvements and new features.

Mini Expansion Focused on the Lich's Journey

The new update will include a mini expansion called "The Search", where the Lich embarks on a journey in pursuit of a powerful artifact rumored to elevate his powers. Get ready to help the Lich on his quest! This content is designed to expand the game's ending.

Polishing Existing Content

Not only will I focus on new features, but I also plan to spend time polishing all of the current game content, ensuring that every gameplay experience is smoother and more enjoyable than ever.

Rebalancing Troops and Defenses

In this update, I will rebalance troops and defenses as needed, adding or tweaking certain abilities to make battles even more strategic and engaging. This adjustment aims to improve balance and provide more options for every encounter.

Artistic Enhancements

I will continue working to improve the game's aesthetics with adjustments and visual enhancements across several key areas.

Listening to Your Feedback

I've been reading all the reviews and opinions from players to understand what matters most and where I should focus my efforts. But if you have more suggestions on what I should tweak or where I should concentrate, I'll be happy to hear them in the comments. Your feedback is essential to the ongoing improvement of Countless Army.

This update is scheduled to arrive in April.

Stay tuned for more details and get ready for what's coming!

notes.title: Getting Closer to Update 1.3.0!
notes.notes:
The 1.3.0 update is just around the corner, and today I want to share some of the exciting features coming your way.

Pause Button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/65f994e21affa32b9fbfb78fd89068c159cd18fd.gif

The pause button was suggested by "MonkeyFonix", and I thought it was a fantastic idea. After exploring how to implement it, I realized that this mechanic not only adds an extra layer of strategy and tactics to the game but also improves the experience for players using a controller. I’m confident many of you will find it both useful!


Army Templates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/b372de4c9d3392b093a2d0f9b43391a7dfaa3c5c.gif

Thanks to the suggestion from "McStuffins T. Fox", a system to save troop configurations has been added. When you select your troops for an invasion, the configuration will now be automatically saved for future invasions, making it much easier to get started.
For those experimenting with different strategies or who simply prefer not to save their configurations, there’s an option to disable this feature. You can find it at the top left of the troop selection screen.


Shortcut List
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/519047df2bf9351b5ec9f9d4e64ff37ef47b1ef7.gif

"Lavan" suggested adding a section in the options menu to display all the shortcuts available in the game. They noticed that some commands weren’t explained in the tutorial, and they were absolutely right. This is a feature that should have been there from the beginning.
After working on its development, I’m happy to present the result! You can now easily check all the shortcuts, whether for keyboard or controller, directly from the options menu.

I hope these new features excite you as much as they do me. The Christmas update will bring even more surprises! Stay tuned for more information coming soon.

notes.title: Testing version, on the way to version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Did you enjoy the Halloween event? I hope so!

Now, it’s time to look to the future... to version 1.3.0. But today is not the day for that; next week, I’ll publish a news update dedicated specifically to it.

Today, I’m asking for your help. As I work on version 1.3.0, I’ll be uploading updates to the game’s beta version, and your feedback on the new content would be invaluable. It will help me understand if you like the additions and identify any bugs to fix.

To access the beta, go to your library, select Countless Army, then Properties, Betas, and enter the code “pruebasCA2024” to download it.

For now, key changes include the addition of Italian and Polish languages (still in progress), a new clearer font, and a defense fix for better performance at higher speeds.

Thank you for your continued support of Countless Army and for helping me make it better each day. I look forward to your opinions and feedback on the beta!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2
notes.notes:
These fixes address the errors reported during this week following the launch of the Halloween event (1.2.0).

Bugs:


 In the map "Cuerno Island," there is a path to rare items at the end (reported by "Jesus101").
 One of the maps in the 6th kingdom could not be replayed (reported by "Biscark").
 The troops: Banshee, Standard Bearer, Observer, Mass and Necromancer displayed different classes in different locations (reported by "idiot5k").
 An error in the map "The Confluence" had an issue with route 2, the one with the mills (it was not well defined) (reported by "idiot5k").
 The achievements related to map difficulty only unlocked if you right-clicked with the mouse and not with any other button in the victory menu.
 The cannon did not fire when the game was at speed x6.
 The achievements for difficulty by capital were not activated.


Regarding the last fix, I am not entirely sure it has been resolved, as it is an error that, no matter how much I try to fix, I cannot seem to solve. However, on this last occasion, I was testing several things, and thanks to a user ("Tekarin"), I was able to confirm that the error comes from the capital of Kingdom 3. Apparently, the data for which level you completed this capital is not being saved correctly.

If it is still not fixed, I would greatly appreciate it if you could report it to me again. I would also like to mention that if I have not managed to fix it yet, you can unlock those achievements by replaying the capital of Kingdom 3 one last time, as even if the data is not saved, you would meet the requirements to achieve the achievements within the same game session.

Thank you very much to everyone who reports errors and helps make the game more polished!

With the launch of version 1.2.0, Halloween is upon us! In some maps, there are special pumpkins that seem to absorb the Lich spell power. The story tells that if you feed them, you will obtain up to six unique skins, only available during the event! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/e100de0419b61c8667159db7cd413ff6b69cbc4e.jpg
The event starts on October 26 and ends on November 4.

With the update, there are also some new features, but not as many as I'd like since time was a bit limited. Here are the highlights of version 1.2.0:

The launch of Countless Army on Mac and Linux! Now you can also enjoy Countless Army on those platforms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/339c66d88d99f2717070f7a610488f3200978287.gif

Control support. Now the game is fully playable with a control. Enjoy it with your favorite control!

The rebellions have been reduced. Now the rebellions pop up with less frequency in the gray skulls and even less in the yellow skulls. The rebel provinces with 3 stars are now also marked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/74155bbe0de03c5ffe839ea04a39d7a3554cfe8f.jpg

Replay maps without a rebellion. Do you want to get three stars in each map but don’t want them to rebel? Do you want to look for the Halloween pumpkins and have everything conquered? Go ahead, now it is possible! However, if the map isn’t one that has rebelled, it won't grant you resources.

Reset button for the skill tree. Now the skill tree has a button to reset it, granting you the spent essences. It has a cost depending on how many upgrades you have.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7dfcdce8d1308c60f122ccd42a7beaeff5c07d79.jpg

I’m sorry I couldn’t add everything mentioned in this version, but don’t worry, in version 1.3.0, all that couldn’t make it to this will come along with some other features!

If you want to know each and every change, here are the patch notes.

Thanks a lot to everyone for being there and enjoying the Halloween event!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Apparently hotfix 1.1.5 brought with it a bug that crashed the game, and this hotfix is ​​to fix that bug.
Also, I managed to find the tutorial bug where you could get stuck in the middle of the second wave and not be able to move the camera.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Before the hotfix of last week that fixed the biggest bugs (the ones that kicked you out of the game or didn’t allow you to play correctly) this week is focused on fixing the other reported bugs. 

Here is the notes of this hotfix:

News:

 Added the option of borderless full screen in the option menu.
 Added the skin “Real Engineer” for the soldier.
 Added the skin “Paddy”.



Bugs fixed:

 Music option had a problem where the values went from -1 to 100 instead of 0 to 100. (Reported by "GiantCanadianGinger")
 The stars sometimes could be seen for a short time in the middle of the screen before they really appear.
 The tutorial had a rare movement when you move the camera.
 The skill tree started with the camera in an incorrect place. Now it starts in the superior part and keep record of the last place you’ve been for the next time.
 Lucas (from the tutorial) also had a rare movement if you move the camera.
 Sometimes the tutorial could crash and won't go forward. Having as the only solution skip it to continue. (Multiple reports)
 The windowed mode had various problems. (Reported by “Syliss”)
 The reaper souls sometimes disappeared.
 An error sometimes made the troops advance over the conquerable building of the wave.
 If you skipped a lot of the weeks, the icons of resources got stuck.
 The reaper and watcher has the description changed(to fit with each one. (reported by “Zone Q11”)
 The skin “Druid” of the necromancer had a problem of colors on his back leg, making it dilute with the background.
 In the skin part, the dragon give some visual bugs when selected.


I hope that this fixes a big part of the game bugs. If you find others don’t hesitate to report them. I’m reading your messages!

Also the Lich is cooking something spooking…stay tuned, because it could leak some info eventually.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.4
notes.notes:
A player has reported an error with achievements:

 The yellow brick road.
 Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
 Dead men tell no tales… They make them.


After checking, they were active only for those who saved in file 2. I am making this hotfix to fix that bug and make everyone able to get them.

If you want to get the achievements, you may have to go through the capitals again.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Today the version 1.1.3 of Countless Army is released, a little hotfix to the biggest errors that you all reported.
This one is focused on fixing the bugs that could make the game crash or that don’t allow you to play the game correctly. I’m reading everything you write and taking notes of the faults, even the ones that are little to fix them, but I’m doing it in order. I’m also reading all of your opinions and shortly I’ll post a new notice talking about the things the version 1.2 will bring. I’ve readed a lot of good ideas!

So, let’s see the changes and errors fixed:

Changes:

 I’ve changed the way the game is compilated, this should make it be better optimized, allowing it to work in each dispositive and give less non consistent errors.
 The speed x8 that unlocks in the end game has been changed to x 6. The x8 made a lot of error(is still in test, it can give some errors but less than the x8).


bugs:

 The drake has an error when you summoned it, making everything after it to not be summoned.
 The necromancer had the CD wrong when you summoned it.
 The drake icon wasn’t visible in the upgrades from the conquerable buildings.
 In the capital of the kingdom 2 the 2nd runic camp was conquered when the troops walked over the route on it.
 A visual bug where the shields appears under the troop.
 The tutorial sometimes crashed on the first wave.
 The necromancer could make the game crash if he made a summon when he entered to conquer a building.
 The mass could crash the game if died when he entered a building.
 The tutorial didn’t get the golden skull if you have the map in 100%(don’t worry, if you get the golden skill in the other maps the tutorial one will change to gold for the achievement of getting all the maps to 100%).
 Sometimes when you realize any action in an invasion the wave sign could disappear making it impossible to start a new wave.
 The troops count to win a map could be negative.
 The dragon could die in the defense “trench” of one hit.


Again, thanks a lot to all for reporting the bugs and for adding suggestions, it helps me a lot!

notes.title: Launch of version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 

Today finally arrives the version 1.1.0, in this notice I want to show every new thing it brings so let’s get to it!

From the start, one of the more notable… A new cover image!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/d9c5d964e762b57198b5aa3e9087406ef59d5106.png

It has been redesigned, but maintaining the old composition. This cover will be the one that represent Countless Army in every site, included the initial meno of the game

The other news is a compilation of the advances I’ve published throughout the development of the version 1.1.0. If you have been looking every advance and want to see the patch notes, here is the link, that also will be in the end of this new.


Continuing i want to show the new victory screen:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/1591bf8846d7d4f497adbe848100b044530ed12a.gif

As you can see, a soft introduction has been added. The victory screen starts slowly part by part, after the animation starts that is completely new, the other components pop in, the speed of the numbers of troops has been augmented… A full face wash to this screen.

Besides, this change comes with new sound effects, that goes with the animation starts and the new troops apparition, conquered zones and obtained resources.


Also we have a new transition:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/fde00621c6fbf8e5f2180b22ee7ca24918b55510.gif

Animation and sounds have been added, making it smoother. Also some camera errors and other things related with transitions are fixed, making this part a lot more polished.


Also the troops will have new skins:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/3e6d0a80e2a99ceaf4a1700e3e8e475c74dfc4ad.png

Each unit has two new skins that you can obtain with the gems in the game.

Remember those are free, you can unlock them while you play.


Next you can see some little changes, such as a little animation on the routes when you choose a unit:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/d1402b8cf3b5e8ab7bab4d98ea6f6480ad2b4024.gif

With this you get a better glimpse of in which position you are placing a troop when you select them, by being more eye-catching.


The cards had changed, now you can choose less troops than cards you have in that moment:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/9b9eca125b6d5e3be8a82cf9b6b93ed19313c678.jpg

With this some bugs that were around the selection of troops and cards have been fixed.


A new unlockable unit has been added to the end game. The idea with this one is to have fun conquering all the kingdoms. I don’t want to make a lot of spoilers so here is the silhouette:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/145592203d691fb3fa0fd4f0d7ceb9cf79b454ef.jpg

Being a unit focused almost to active the “easy” mode, this one has a lot of power by itself and helps the surrounding units.


All this and others are the things that bring the version 1.1.0, as I said earlier, here is the link so you can see all the patch notes.

Thanks a lot from being here

Enjoy this new version!

notes.title: Notes of version 0.9.2:
notes.notes:
Hello! 

I’ve had some complaints about the difficulty, and even if I want a game that is a little complicated, I don’t want to leave people without playing Countless Army because of this. For this reason and even if a big update is coming on the freeday,  I want to bring you this quick update to fix it.

Notes of version 0.9.2:

 Added an option to change letters font.
 Added an option to choose game difficulty. Being able to play in easy(-40% damage), normal(the current version of the game) and hard(+20% damage).
 The first two maps have been changed to be more accessible. They weren’t impossible but not for much.


I recommend playing the easy difficulty for those that aren’t very familiar with strategy games or to people that can’t get through the normal difficulty.
The normal difficulty is the one in which the game was designed originally and is the one in which I think the game has to be played.
The hard difficulty is not fully tested, so I’m working on it.


Even the difficulty and the letters font can be changed in the option menu in any moment:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/52e73718a902d8d029982a207d85a5bac69a3d10.jpg

Besides this you have to choose a difficulty at the start of each game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7986b9c68f7a4707bb4dcd2560ff36970214d06e.jpg

I hope this gets better access to new players.

I love to receive your comments about the new difficulty modes, to know if they are balanced or are very easy/very hard to balance them better.

See you in the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/151ff2db2ad6c6ddf7f122ad35034328b754cf69.gif
